(1) This Order may be cited as the Town Planners Registration Order, 2014 and shall commence on a date to be appointed by the Minister, with the approval the SuHan and Yang Di-Pertuan, by notification in the Gazette.

(2) The long title of this Order is "An Order to provide for the registration of town planners and for purposes connected therewith or incidental thereto".

In this Order, unless the context otherwise requires - member" means a member of the Board appointed under 3(2){b) or {c); means the Board of Town Planners established by section 3(1); of registration" means a certificate of registration issued under means the chairman of the Board; means the Minister charged with the responsibility for town planning matters; means the town planning profession; means the Register of Town Planners referred to in section 12; means the Registrar of Town Planners referred to in section 11.

OF TOWN PLANNERS Establishment and constitution of Board.

{ 1) is hereby established a board known as the Board of Town

(2) The Board shall consist of the following members - {a} the Commissioner for Town and Country Planning, who shall be the chairman; {b) 4 persons appointed by the Minister who are town planners or who are members of Royal Town Planning Institute of the United or any other internationally recognised professional body approved by the Minister; {c) one person appointed by the Minister from locally recognised professional bodies approved by the Minister.

(3) The period of appointment of members, other than the chairman, shall be 3 years, but such members shall be eligible for re-appointment. {4) by the Board shall, notwithstanding any vacancy in the or that it is afterwards discovered that there was a defect in the of any person purporting to be a member thereof, be as valid as if no such vacancy or defect had existed. of Board.

(1) No person shall, unless he is registered, take or use the name or title of town planner or arty other word in any language having the same or a similar or being to the like intent or take or use any other name, title, emblem or description implying that his name or the name of any person employed by him is registered or that he or such other person is entitled to be registered.

(2) A person who acts in contravention of subsection (1) is guilty of an and liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $1,000 and to a further fine of $100 for every day during which the offence continues after conviction. eligible for registration.

Subject to this Order the following persons are eligible to be registered - (a} any person employed as a town planner at the date of of this Order;

(b) any person who is a member of Royal Town Planning Institute of the United Kingdom or any other internationally recognised professional town planning or who is a holder of such other qualification as the Minister may declare by notification in the Gazette to be an approved qualification for the purposes of this section, who has complied with such conditions as the Board may determine. for registration.

(1) Any person eligible for registration under this Order may apply to the Board for registration. !2) Every application made to the Board shall be accompanied by a nonrefundable application fee of a prescribed amount which shall be paid in the specified by the Board and in such form and manner as the Board may of certificates of registration.

(1) The Registrar shall issue to any town planner whose application for registration has been approved by the Board, a certificate of registration in a form by the Board upon payment of the prescribed fee.

(2) The certificate shall -

(a) expire on the 31st December of the year in which it was issued; and

(b) be renewable annually upon payment of the prescribed fee.
Every registered town planner shall notify the Registrar of any change in his business address or correspondence address within 14 days of such change. from Register.

The Registrar shall remove from the Register the name and other particulars town planner who - {a) has died; {b) has failed to renew his registration within 3 months of its expiry; {c) has been registered through an error as to his qualification for {d) who has applied in writing for such removal. of Board to cancel certificate and remove name from Register.

(1) Subject to this section, the Board may direct that a certificate be and the name and other particulars of a registered town planner be removed from the Register if - {a) he has been convicted of an offence involving fraud or dishonesty; {b) he has been adjudged bankrupt; {c) he becomes of unsound mind; {d) he has been convicted of an offence under this Order; {e) his registration has been obtained by fraud or misrepresentation; {f) his qualification for registration under section 12 has been or cancelled by the authority through which it was acquired or by which it was awarded; {g) he has been found guilty of an improper act or conduct which renders him, in the opinion of the Board, unfit to be a town planner; or {h) it appears to the Board that he is unable to carry out the duties of a town planner effectively in Brunei Darussalam.

(2) No direction shall be given under subsection {1} unless the Board has the registered town planner to whom it relates an opportunity of being heard either personally or by counsel.

(3) A direction under subsection (1) shall not take effect until the expiration month from the date on which it has been communicated to the registered town planner to whom it relates or, where an appeal against the direction has been made to the Minister under section 23, until the appeal has been determined or withdrawn.

(4) Where a direction under subsection (J) takes effect, the Registrar shall make such alteration in the Register as is necessary to give effect to it. of certificate of registration.

A town planner in public office shall be exempted from payment of any fee pursuant to this Order. Fraudulent registration.

Any person who, in an application for registration under this Order, makes, produces or causes to be made or produced, any false on fraudulent representation, certificate or declaration, either verbally or in writing, or who or assists therein is guilty of an offence and liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $5,000, imprisonment for a term not exceeding 6 months or both. 14th. 2014

Any person who contravenes or fails to comply with any provision of this for which no other penalty is expressly provided is guilty of an offence and on conviction to a fine not exceeding $5,000, imprisonment for a term not year or both and, in the case of a continuing offence, to a further fine not exceeding $500 for every day during which the offence continues after No action in absence of bad faith.

No action or proceeding shall lie against the Board, any committee or any thereof for any act or thing done or omitted to be done in good faith in the discharge or purported discharge of its or his duties under this Order.
